subsenses.definition: That which causes something: an efficient cause, a proximate cause.
examples: The reason this tree fell is that it had rotted.

subsenses.definition: A motive for an action or a determination.
examples: He made reason with his boss about taking a day off.
The reason I robbed the bank was that I needed the money.
If you don't give me a reason to go with you, I won't.
This is the reason why he proposes to offer a libation, to atone for the abuse of the day by their diversions.
